mapper.select: SELECT a.`processtask_id` as processTaskId, a.`form_uuid` as formUuid, a.`form_name` as formName, a.`form_content_hash` as formContentHash, b.`content` as formContent FROM `processtask_form` a JOIN `processtask_form_content` b ON b.`hash` = a.`form_content_hash` WHERE a.`processtask_id` = #{value}
